summary: Iteration 29: tested new HYBRID VALUATION ENGINE on /api/goal (methods auto|revenue|ebitda + custom multiple + persistence) and the /meta UI (method card, multiple slider, reset, persistence across Calcular Projeção, report regression). Backend 7/7 pytest pass; frontend end-to-end flow works. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: goals.py: correctly uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so partial POSTs don't wipe unrelated fields, and only $unsets value_multiple_custom when it is explicitly sent as null. Good behavior verified in tests.
core.suggest_multiples defaults to 'Geral' (revenue 1.0x, ebitda 5.0x) for empty sector — expected but consider surfacing hint in UI when sector is missing so users know to configure it.
EBITDA fallback in _compute_projection is profit*1.3 (heuristic). Already flagged as 'estimado' in the UI — acceptable.
Metas.jsx is ~720 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the valuation-method card and scenarios/sliders into subcomponents in the future.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing admin goal (750000, 5y) and YTD (200000 through 2026-06).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_goal_valuation_hybrid.py. Run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_goal_valuation_hybrid.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''`. Admin sector is empty -> defaults sugerido revenue 1.0x ebitda 5.0x. Verified: (a) valuation object shape with sector_label/region/revenue{min,suggested,max}/ebitda{...}; (b) method=revenue → current_value = revenue*used_multiple, required.required_revenue = target/used_multiple; (c) method=ebitda with custom=6 → current_value = ebitda*6, required.required_ebitda = target/6, ebitda_margin computed; (d) partial POST with only target_value keeps custom multiple (exclude_unset); (e) explicit null clears override back to suggested; (f) method=auto restores automatic engine; (g) share endpoint still works. Frontend confirmed: method-auto/revenue/ebitda buttons switch card; slider only shown for revenue/ebitda; slider drag updates multiple-value + meta-current-value; multiple-reset resets to sector suggested; custom multiple persists through Calcular Projeção; report-btn navigates to /relatorio-meta which correctly shows 'método EBITDA · 5.5×'.
